about_the_game: This demo includes the tutorial section of the game, including the first boss fight. Currently, the demo only supports 2 players via online multiplayer. Both Players will need to have the demo installed to play. Optimization will be improved in the full release. The game is still actively in development.

content_descriptors.notes: Dark-Fanstasy/Action combat and themes of death/war.

short_description: Soul Chained is a Co-op action adventure where the players are chained together. Play the roles of rival warlords forced to work together to ascend to the afterlife.
